name: Hunefer
source:
A necromancer and ancient scribe who loved Tutankhamun so much that she was resurrected.

"The footsteps of Lord Khamun... Giza Hieroglyph!!"

One of Tutankhamun's servants in Eiyuu Senki WWX.
